description: Heads-up push/fold Nash equilibrium: no ante, chip EV, solved with CFR+ by tools/gen_pushfold.cpp

game.stack: effective stack in big blinds, before the blinds are posted

solver.method: CFR+ (regret matching+, alternating updates, linear averaging); the average strategy

exploitability: the average over the two players of what a best response gains against the other player's strategy, in big blinds per hand, computed exactly for the probabilities as written in this file

grid.layout: row r, column c: the pair on the diagonal; suited above it (row = higher rank), offsuit below it (column = higher rank)
